pairs.description: Garlic supplements substantially decrease the plasma concentrations of saquinavir by approximately 50 percent in healthy human volunteers.
pairs.mechanism: Induction of intestinal P-glycoprotein transport and cytochrome P450 3A4 enzymes by garlic constituents.

pairs.description: High-dose garlic intake inhibits platelet aggregation and may prolong bleeding time, intensifying bleeding hazards in patients receiving warfarin.
pairs.mechanism: Allicin and ajoene inhibit platelet aggregation and thromboxane synthesis, enhancing anticoagulant hazards.

pairs.description: Garlic supplements may decrease circulating levels of protease inhibitors including atazanavir, risking suboptimal antiretroviral suppression.
pairs.mechanism: Modulation of enteric P-glycoprotein transport proteins reducing systemic protease inhibitor bioavailability.
